notes.title: New Class “Engineer” Coming Early 2026!
notes.content: [h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p][/p][p]It’s been about three months since the full release of Backpack Battles. During this time, we’ve mainly been rolling out balance updates while also working behind the scenes on the design of a brand-new class. Now, it’s finally time to reveal her![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to officially introduce the seventh class coming to Backpack Battles – the Engineer! She’s currently in early development and is planned to release in early 2026. [b]If you own the game, she will be available as a free update![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/fee3ee5d293f66cfb673679a01a29b1c8c2e4cb2.png"][/img][/p][p]A core mechanic of the Engineer will be shooting electrical charges, which provide bonuses as they travel over the items in her inventory. Some items can emit these charges, manipulate them, or benefit from them—like the Battery, which actively emits a charge.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to electricity, the Engineer will also explore some secondary themes, such as stamina manipulation and advancing item cooldowns under specific conditions. These systems are still being tested and refined, so things may change before her final release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/2bc6de85722d6d73206e24400879f993b80dfb55.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We can’t wait for you to try her out and see what strategies you come up with! We’ll share more updates on her development as things progress, so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: 🎨 Backpack Battles Creative Contest! 🎨
notes.content:

notes.title: Surprise hit indie game Backpack Battles launches into 1.0 with two new classes
notes.content:
When I saw the reveal of Resident Evil Requiem, my mind immediately conjured up one of the series' most iconic moments - playing inventory Tetris in RE4. Most don't handle it that well; sorting out your items is typically one of the most frustrating parts of games, with RPGs such as Diablo 4 and Baldur's Gate 3 among the big offenders. Backpack Battles changes that. The indie game proved an instant hit when it launched into early access in 2024, selling 100,000 copies in a single day. Now, just over a year later, Backpack Battles 1.0 is here, adding two new classes and much more, and it's yours for 20% off if you're quick.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: FULL RELEASE!! Backpack Battles Patch 1.0 is Here
notes.content: [h2][b]Hi everyone! 🎉[/b][/h2][h2][b]Backpack Battles is coming out of early access today!! [/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="1H0NcstTlKo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]🌟 Mage & Adventurer are here! ✨[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/af656c439111c2787905fca2c7eb005cab1ea4f0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427700/Backpack_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can play them right now! But before that, let's take a look back at the history of Backpack Battles...[/p][p][/p][h1]How it started...[/h1][p][/p][p]I can’t believe it’s finally time to write this post.[/p][p]It really has been a crazy ride from the very first demo until here.[/p][p]I know some of you have been with us from the very start, back when there were like two recipes in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We had a 9-month-long phase where we worked on the demo, adding content every week and just checking out how y’all reacted to it, and what it did to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]This is an unconventional way of making games.[/p][p]Almost everything in Backpack Battles was developed entirely in the open, most of the time there was less than a week between us having an idea and actually adding it to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]You know, we did plan to do this as a small side project - it becoming a years long project instead of a few months long is entirely because of your continued interest in this game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/61cdb276bc2084615a63cab564e07797311965bd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]...and what it became[/h2][p][/p][p]Most of the features we now can’t imagine the game without were the results of coming up with a crazy idea, putting it in, seeing how you guys react, often doing a poll, and then reevaluating where to go from here.[/p][p][/p][p][b]These are just some things we only came up with along the way:[/b][/p][p]Moving bags, subclasses, unique treasures, class badges, alternative loadouts, the build history, the item library, skills, lobbies and so many more. And there are many more things we could and would like to add.[/p][p][/p][p]We went from a game where the lategame could only be Bloodthorne or Lightsabers (because those were the only lategame weapons in the game at the time), to a game where I still have things happen in my runs that I have never had before. [/p][p][/p][p]It really wasn’t inevitable to have all those things. But I’m so glad we did not end at 50 items and 2 classes. We added classes #3 and #4 (Berserker and Pyromancer) with the start of the early access.[/p][p][/p][p]Now you can finally play classes #5 and #6 (Mage and Adventurer). We added 161 items during the demo phase, 183 during the early access, and another 95 now.[/p][p]In total, there are now [b]439 items[/b] in the game. That’s a lot of stuff, it really became more than we ever imagined it would be. But of course, there are tons of things we want to add in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the Mage and the Adventurer, and all the other small things we put in Backpack Battles for your amusement.[/p][p][/p][h1]Have fun and thank you![/h1][h3]Thanks for staying with us, or for checking us out. For recommending our game or for streaming it. For leaving a nice review, or reporting bugs. And just for enjoying the game. Without you, the game would have been very different.[/h3][p][/p][p]We also want to thank our partners at IndieArk, who have supported us since the early demo days and brought this game to so many players all around the world. Also, our thanks go out to our playtesters - we wouldn’t have been able to do this without you.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m sure you will hear from us soon, with the usual fixes and adjustments.[/p][p][/p][p]- Doro and Mario ❤[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Tiny Pasture X Backpack Battles: New Bundle![/h2][p][/p][p]We just launched a bundle with a super cute game: Tiny Pasture! It's a cozy simulation game that sits at the bottom of your desktop where you build a farm with critters.[/p][p][/p][p]You can even bring a Rainbow Goobert into your little farm now! Isn't it adorable?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/e1724a5b49efb41499ee0642c2a0b9d8ade3bd3a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Check out the bundle:[/p][p][dynamiclink notes.title: 🎒 Backpack Battles 1.0 is Coming June 13th!! 🎒
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone - Big news today![/h3]

We have been working away behind the scenes and can’t wait to show you what we have been doing:

[h2]Here’s the trailer![/h2]

[previewyoutube=4506C29cYO4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Backpack Battles will finally hit version [b]1.0 on June 13th[/b], with 2 whole new characters as well as items for the 4 existing classes.[/h3]

We will leave some surprises open for when you can actually play it, but here are some details:
The two new classes are the [b]Mage[/b] and the [b]Adventurer[/b].

[quote]The [b]Mage[/b] is a bit more complex than the previous classes, with a focus on interesting patterns and buff management.

If you feel like even more puzzling you can choose the Puzzlebox, to place tetrimino-shaped bags. They have a ton of cool Mage-y stuff like wands, spell scrolls, spell books etc, but you best discover them for yourself ;)[/quote]
[quote]The [b]Adventurer[/b] is themed around variety and variance. Her main loadout, the Bag of Giving, works a bit like a combination of Rainbow Badge and Present: It lets you access other classes’ items and generate them randomly. It’s pretty wild, and we hope you will love it as much as we do!

There is of course a more tame alternative with her other loadout, which focuses more on tying neutral items together with Twine.[/quote]

They both will have a full set of items from the start with 5 subclasses, class-specific skills, and a nice set of class items.

There will also be a lot of quality-of-life improvements and polish, but you will see those for yourself soon!


[h3]And there is another thing to celebrate: We have hit [b]1,000,000 sold copies[/b] of Backpack Battles. It’s still so hard to comprehend so many of you are playing our game, thanks y’all! ❤[/h3]

- Dorothea & Mario

notes.title: A Year Full of Backpacks!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

We hope you had wonderful holidays so far!

[b]With 2024 coming to an end, it's time for a quick look back and a glimpse into the future of Backpack Battles.[/b]

For the development team (meaning Doro and Mario), this year was without a doubt one of the most exciting and wild ones ever.

We entered Early Access in early March and it was without exaggeration an overwhelming once-in-a-lifetime success. Collectively, all Backpack Battles players have a total of [b]30 million hours[/b] (or around 3500 years), which is mindboggling.

[b]Thank you so much, everybody![/b]

Since then, we did everything in our power to make this game as good as it can be.

We added many features, many of which were planned and part of the roadmap - and many of which came up over the last nine months.

So here are some highlights of things we added during the year:

[list]
[*] We had the honor to work with the devs of other indie games we know and love on [b]crossover[/b] content, such as Balatro, Claws & Chaos, Magicraft, and Wildfrost!
[*] We added [b]class badges[/b], so accessing the items of multiple classes at once became possible
[*] We added [b]loadouts[/b], enabling more playstyles for each class as well as the option to start with a random selection of items
[*] We added a [b]history[/b] where you can see your previous runs and do more fights with them!
[*] We added [b]skills[/b] to make runs more varied and dynamic
[*] And just now, we added [b]lobbies[/b] so you can play with your friends and [b]Custom rules[/b] (both for lobbies and unranked games) for whacky fun runs.
[*] …And of course there also were the Rainbow Goobert and Ranger plushies :)
[/list]
With the 0.9 update and during Early Access, we added a total of [b]173[/b] different items! (15 of them being Treasure uniques) - [b]90[/b] of them coming with the 28 major updates during the EA.

[h2]…Towards the launch[/h2]

Originally, we planned to leave early access within 3-6 months. Looking back - well, we didn't.
As it typically goes, cool ideas pop up during development. And after checking back with you guys on Discord, we decided that taking our time and not closing ourselves off to cool stuff is the better way. This allowed us to implement features like the [b]History[/b], [b]Skills[/b], and [b]Loadout options[/b] that we would not want to miss from the game anymore.

One thing you can be sure of is that we are going to fully release in 2025 though! (Stay tuned for an actual announcement)
We have been working on both the [b]Mage[/b] and the [b]Adventurer[/b] in the background the whole time, and lot of progress has been made.

notes.title: Custom Games & Lobbies Now Live! (Backpack Battles Patch 0.9.28)
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone,[/h2]

[b]The next big update is ready to be rolled out![/b]
Besides new items, the main focus is on the new modes: Unranked with [b]custom rules[/b] and [b]lobbies[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/fbef6643a20c09f890d596ae463fd4fa46192c06.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/1b20175267826277b87125f70b430434de6449eb.jpg[/img]

[b]Behind this, there are currently two things: [/b]

[olist]
[*] [b]Custom unranked games[/b] that allow you to queue against a ranking bracket of your choosing and select custom rules.

[*] The option to [b]create or join lobbies[/b].
[/olist]
Of course, this is also a nice place where more custom modes could find their home in the future.

[h3]What Lobbies Are[/h3]

Lobbies are designed as a mode to play with a friend or many friends at a time!

You open a lobby by selecting “Host lobby” which will generate a 6-letter lobby code.

Your friends can then join by pressing “Join Lobby” and entering that code. 

All players will play at the same time, with a timer (configurable at the start) ending the shop phase. You will then be matched against one of the other lobby members. Your goal is to win as many rounds out of 18 as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/a45d6dde9ea6a67d60103c012990048500afb484.jpg[/img]

[h3]What Lobbies Are Not[/h3]

Lobbies are not planned to become a public mode where anybody can join, this also means it will not be ranked.


[h3]The Future[/h3]

Currently, there are 3 types of custom rules that can be enabled for unranked games - there are lots of opportunities to expand on that. We would love to hear your ideas for interesting custom rules as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/3f616e5af96c2a86ac79c110717c39142154b7cc.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Look Behind The Scenes[/h2]
We have been working on the lobbies behind the scenes for about a year now and for us, finally being able to show them is a huge milestone towards the game's full release.
When we started developing Backpack Battles, it was planned to become a tiny experimental side project.

Since then, the game’s popularity exploded, and even though we decided to keep developing as a two-person team, we were able to commit to the project full-time.

We never considered adding a synchronous mode to this asynchronous game, but with the decision to make it our main project, we had the resources to consider the massive undertaking of adding a synchronous mode. 

We are so hyped to finally get this feature out to you, and hope you have fun playing with a buddy or two! :)

[h2]Changelog for 0.9.28[/h2]
[list]
[*] NEW MODE: Custom Rules Unranked
[*] NEW MODE: Lobbies where you can fight your friends!
[*] Overhauled item activation animations: They now jump, swing, wave, squish etc depending on their type when they activate!
[*] NEW RECIPE: Shelly
[*] NEW RECIPE: Poison Spear
[*] NEW RECIPE: Holdall
[*] NEW TREASURE ITEM: Lil Chestnut
[*] NEW SKILL: Dig Deeper
[*] NEW SKILL: Knife to Meet You
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Neutral[/b]
[list]
[*] Falcon Blade: Speed bonus 30% -> 35%
[*] Lightsaber: Cost 12 -> 11
[*] Amulet of Darkness: Damage needed per debuff: 20 -> 22

[*] Blood Manipulation: Cooldown 3.5s -> 4.0s

[/list]

notes.title: The ❄COOL❄ Update Is Now Live - 18 New Items, Build History, Skins & More!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

We have more great news! Not only do we have a big patch coming to the main branch (more on this in a second), we can finally [b]reveal our collab with one of our favorite deckbuilders: Wildfrost[/b].

Fitting perfectly into the theme of this update, we add the Snowcake as an Unique item and a craftable Snow Stick. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/b702ba86a3b18ca6e71616b21f692228cae8ecba.png[/img]

There is also a Ranger skin based on Yuki, and just as in Wildfrost, her snowball grows over time! And of course, the other classes get a skin as well, check out Doom Cap Reaper, Shaman Beserker and Dark Pyromancer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/8d7461dcc1ba84ca877a79f6102655faa8625e40.png[/img]

We also have a bundle available, where you can purchase both games with an additional 10% discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46297

[h2]New Items![/h2]

But wait, there is more. We are adding [b]10 more skills[/b], so the game now features 30 skills in total. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/b1f16ba157de88216b407439075421faab27577c.jpg[/img]

Only one of the new skills is class-specific - [b]Heart of the Cards[/b] requires you to have a Deck of Cards. This is for testing the "Requires" keyword.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/c016219a443b8c9802e18fc7b39a7f80a4713359.png[/img]

The new skills [b]Just Stats[/b] and [b]More Stats[/b] will be available in the same slot every run, and offer an alternative to rolling away the skills in case none of them fit your current build.
Of course, picking a fitting skill should still be the better option. 

The [b]Wonky Snowman[/b] is a new shop item that breaks up into two Snowballs. [b]Snowball[/b] is the new crafting ingredient for Ice items instead of the Spell Scroll: Frostbolt, which makes them accessible earlier and for all classes. This will of course come with adjustments to the Cryomancer subclass.

We reworked the [b]Ripsaw Blade[/b] with a completely new mechanic: It removes temporary damage from opponent weapons. It also got its first crafting successor, the [b]Katana[/b]!

The other new items are the [b]Amulet of Darkness[/b], a new variant of the Unidentified Amulet, and two recipes: You can now craft [b]Stone Shoes[/b] and the [b]Shepherd's Crook[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/7c1c536dc159401b215e74e818fd98d8bfcd6548.png[/img]

[h2]New Tooltips & Icons[/h2]

We gave item types an overhaul: Elemental types like Ice, Holy, etc. are now represented as [b]icons[/b].

We also added icons for different types of damage, you can find them on weapons and other damage-dealing items. The current damage types are Melee, Ranged, and Effect damage - with Effect damage collecting more indirect damage sources. We added several items to buff or counter Effect damage in this update. 

We also revised all item texts and made some changes to improve tooltip readability! Please give yourself a moment to get used to the new tooltips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/9bc3e3b7427fd0f2a53ac0ef6545e68308631b9e.jpg[/img]

You can now also filter for these types in the item library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/795df36a6ac3478709c9e3df71bed2fd7ea9a108.jpg[/img]

[h2]Build History[/h2]

The big quality-of-life feature for this patch is the [b]Build History[/b]. 

It keeps the full progression of your builds throughout your runs. And as a little bonus, you can start additional [b]fights[/b] to find out how the build would have performed against different opponents.

This also means that you can send your round 18 backpack out to fight as often as you want, which was a commonly requested feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/0d9f552bd304e8be72ee523463fdf6ec00979b19.jpg[/img]

And there's more! You can now [b]press Alt[/b] while hovering over an item to show all the recipes it can build into! This was requested a bunch of times, and we found a way to display the recipes nicely. As always, we do our best to make features as useful as possible - the tooltips also show which items you already own and which ones can be bought from the current shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/ea0bdc0bfcf8e7877165c7b497ab87ee75979021.jpg[/img]

[h2]More Languages[/h2]

With this update, the game now supports Latin American Spanish, French, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese! You can change the language in the options if Steam doesn't apply it automatically.
We hope this makes the game accessible to more players around the world! 

[h2]Magicraft Crossover[/h2]

In case you missed it, we just added Pop and Cthulhu from Magicraft as Unique items last week! They just had their 1.0 release - and don't forget you can get it with a discount if you already own Backpack Battles:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46693



By the way, our publisher is also holding an annual publisher sale.✨ Go take a look and grab some amazing games: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/indiearkpublishersale2024/
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/indiearkpublishersale2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/a6a06a8b680c3611946f4f871e8282643348577d.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: A ❄COOL❄ Update Hits Beta Branch
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone,[/h2]

[h3]Another big patch is ready for beta testing![/h3]

The focus of this upcoming update is to fill in gaps in the existing items, with 10 more skills and several new recipes alongside some item reworks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/e963ef218b74048433aeb09a0cf701bfc1950030.png[/img]

[h2]New Skills[/h2]

We are adding [b]10 more skills[/b], so the game now features 30 skills in total. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/b1f16ba157de88216b407439075421faab27577c.jpg[/img]

Only one of the new skills is class-specific - [b]Heart of the Cards[/b] requires you to play Reaper and have a Deck of Cards. This is for testing the "Requires" keyword.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/c016219a443b8c9802e18fc7b39a7f80a4713359.png[/img]

The new skills [b]Just Stats[/b] and [b]More Stats[/b] will be available in the same slot every run, and offer an alternative to rolling away the skills in case none of them fit your current build.
Of course, picking a fitting skill should still be the better option. 


[h2]New Items[/h2]

The [b]Wonky Snowman[/b] is a new shop item that breaks up into two Snowballs. [b]Snowball[/b] is the new crafting ingredient for Ice items instead of the Spell Scroll: Frostbolt, which makes them accessible earlier and for all classes. This will of course come with adjustments to the Cryomancer subclass.

We reworked the [b]Ripsaw Blade[/b] with a completely new mechanic: It removes temporary damage from opponent weapons. It also got its first crafting successor, the [b]Katana[/b]!

The other new items are the [b]Amulet of Darkness[/b], a new variant of the Unidentified Amulet, and two recipes: You can now craft [b]Stone Shoes[/b] and the [b]Shepherd's Crook[/b].

[h2]New Tooltips & Icons[/h2]

We gave item types an overhaul: Elemental types like Ice, Holy, etc. are now represented as [b]icons[/b].

We also added icons for different types of damage, you can find them on weapons and other damage-dealing items. The current damage types are Melee, Ranged, and Effect damage - with Effect damage collecting more indirect damage sources. We added several items to buff or counter Effect damage in this update. 

We also revised all item texts and made some changes to improve tooltip readability! Please give yourself a moment to get used to the new tooltips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/9bc3e3b7427fd0f2a53ac0ef6545e68308631b9e.jpg[/img]

You can now also filter for these types in the item library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/795df36a6ac3478709c9e3df71bed2fd7ea9a108.jpg[/img]

[h2]Build History[/h2]

The big quality-of-life feature for this patch is the [b]Build History[/b]. 

It keeps the full progression of your builds throughout your runs. And as a little bonus, you can start additional [b]fights[/b] to find out how the build would have performed against different opponents.

This also means that you can send your round 18 backpack out to fight as often as you want, which was a commonly requested feature! Please use the beta branch to test the History thoroughly :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/0d9f552bd304e8be72ee523463fdf6ec00979b19.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Beta Branch[/h2]

We have instructions on how to join the branch on our [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]Discord server[/url]. 
Please keep in mind that the goal of the beta branch is to [b]find bugs and issues[/b]!
The update is planned to go live on November 7th, coming with balancing changes and some more surprises! 😊

[h2](Prelimilary) Changelog for 0.9.24[/h2]
[list]
[*] NEW ITEM: Wonky Snowman / Snowball
[*] NEW SKILL: Heavy Drinking
[*] NEW SKILL: Buy the Holy Light
[*] NEW SKILL: Girl Power
[*] NEW SKILL: Blood Manipulation
[*] NEW SKILL: Bagtacular
[*] NEW SKILL: Uniquely Unique
[*] NEW SKILL: Thornburst
[*] NEW SKILL: Just Stats
[*] NEW SKILL: More Stats
[*] NEW SKILL (Reaper): Heart of the Cards

[/list]

[list]

[*] Ripsaw Blade: Now removes gained damage from items and gains damage. No longer removes buffs

[*] Ice Dragon: Now also reduces effect damage

notes.title: Skill Update Hits Beta Branch!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

The upcoming update is both the biggest and most experimental yet!

[b]In rounds 4 and 10 you will be able to pick 1 out of 3 [i]Skills[/i]. 

Skills are a special kind of item that mixes up the gameplay and opens up now kinds of builds.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/58fa74b9bbf72b5206e0357dff2533a7e2f4e29c.jpg[/img]

Here are two examples. [i]It’s Slime Time[/i] can drop in round 4 and gives you access to [i]Gooblings[/i], a new item, and is the basis for a Goobert-based strategy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/5aaea7776911a80631742283e6356989520f2051.jpg[/img]

[i]Mana Mastery[/i] is a Skill that can be found in both round 4 and round 10. It is a Mana source and makes Mana Orbs a more effective payoff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/19ce6a49e2b3635980a02d199ca7e6559b0d5cec.jpg[/img]

Currently, there is a total of [b]20 skills[/b], some can only be found in round 4, some only in round 10 and some of them are in both pools (you can check this in the item info panel). Each class has 2 class-specific skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/b4cb1bb754f72a9f654f4bb7cb56c850a2073ea0.png[/img]


This is a very experimental feature that we have great hopes for. After a sufficiently long testing period, we plan to start a poll on our Discord to see if you like it as much as we do, and plan our following steps accordingly.

[h3]Joining the Beta[/h3]

You can play it by joining the public beta branch. If you have never participated before, you can instructions on how to join on our [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]Discord server[/url]. It is planned to come to the main branch on 20th September. Until then, have fun testing and do not forget: [b]The beta branch is for finding issues, bugs are to be expected[/b] - please [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]report them in our Discord[/url] or the steam community so they can be addressed.

[h3]Future Updates[/h3]

While this is the last major mechanic we plan to integrate in the game, we are still working on the private [b]lobbies [/b](play with friends) as well as different quality-of-life features. We will also add many more items, including a second set of skills! With the 1.0 release, we will add [b]two more classes[/b] and Steam [b]achievements[/b].

notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

A while ago we stumbled across the idea to give characters the option to choose different starting bags for different playstyles. According to a poll at the time, most of you seemed interested in that idea, so we got to work, and you can [b]try it out now[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/d4145b660be324cd8d3d27260eee60c7130da155.png[/img]

[h2]Alternative Loadouts[/h2]

[*] Pyromancer: Offering Bowl

[h2]Additional Uniques & More[/h2]
We also add 5 more Uniques, and increase the chance to find unique items.
There is also a new Epic item you can try, the [b]Unstable Recombobulator[/b].

[b]If all goes well, 0.9.16 is planned to go to the main branch on Sunday, August 11[/b]. Balance changes to the existing items will also be implemented when the patch goes to main branch.


[h2]The Beta Branch[/h2]
On [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]our Discord server[/url], you can find instructions on how to join the beta. 
[h3]The new content needs testing - bugs are to be expected. If you encounter any, please report them on our Discord server.[/h3]

notes.title: Summer Update OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

Backpack Battles is part of the [b]Steam Summer Sale with a 10% discount[/b]!

And our [b]biggest update yet[/b] is live right now with many new items and quality-of-life features that were requested by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/01f91514bd0fdc59037d94511fb52628a7889450.jpg[/img]

[h3]The New Items![/h3]

We added a total of [b]15 items[/b] of different kinds.
There are 5 items that you can buy directly from the shop. This was based on this poll we made on [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]our Discord server[/url] btw!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/57f8b5084d3b9c76d12ef6219b2deb132f70c3cd.jpg[/img]

One of these items is the [b]Unidentified Amulet[/b], which transforms into one of 6 different new amulets. 
We also added [b]5 new recipes[/b].

Within this item set, there are some new mechanics like: 
[list]
[*] A weapon that uses stamina to generate Empower
[*] Items that are Magic, Holy, Dark and Vampiric all at the same time
[*] The first craftable bag
[*] A way to damage ranged opponents with Spikes
[*] And more!
[/list]
That being said, it is to be expected that some of these new items will require balance adjustments in the future or push existing builds over the edge, so expect [b]balance adjustments[/b] in the following weeks until we are happy with the state!

Speaking of balance… before we get there, here are some [b]quality-of-life highlights[/b] of this version:

[h3]The combat log has grown more powerful![/h3]
[olist]
[*] It now tracks when (de)buffs are reflected, nullified, resisted, protected, or prevented. 
[*] When you hover over the entries after battle, it now restores states of items like potions, playing cards etc. as well as cooldowns and Battle Rage. 
[*] We also added [b]replay buttons[/b]! 
[*] The meters now show the [b]totals[/b] of damage done and stacks gained etc. and there are new ones for how often weapons missed attacks and were Out-of-stamina, activations and maximum health gained (all with plots!). 
[*] In the panel above the combat log, you can choose if you want to see log entries for [b]when an item activates[/b]. 
[*] Last, but not least music will now play after battle so you can inspect the combat log while listening to some nice medieval soundtrack by alkacrab! 
[/olist]
Also, the inventory now has an [b]Undo/redo[/b] feature you can use if your restructuring did not quite work out as you have imagined. Just press Ctrl+Z to undo the last action and Ctrl+Y to redo it. 

We want to thank everyone who tested the new stuff and reported bugs - this makes it possible for us to add new content so quickly.
And now to the change log, including all that is new and balance changes!

[h3]But wait, there’s one more thing![/h3]
There’s only one week left to order the [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/rainbow-goobert-plush]Rainbow Goobert plushie[/url] - so get your colorful cuddly blob now!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/rainbow-goobert-plush][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/817518409f46efb5058b445f6b9d6c8f7afd37de.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Full Changelog for 0.9.12[/h1]
[h2]New Content & Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] NEW ITEM: Prismatic Orb
[*] NEW ITEM: Unidentified Amulet (+Amulet of Life, Amulet of Feasting, Amulet of Energy, Amulet of the Wild, Amulet of Alchemy, Amulet of Steel)
[*] NEW ITEM (Reaper): Toad 
[*] NEW RECIPE: Prismatic Sword

[*] NEW ITEM: Shiny Shell
[*] NEW RECIPE: Shell Totem
[*] NEW ITEM: Oil Lamp

[*] Added an UNDO FUNCTION! You can go back to old inventory placements with Ctrl+Z, redo with Ctrl+Y, define snapshots with Ctrl+ [1 to 9], and load them by pressing the same number (this only affects placements and can of course not revert buy/sell/crafting etc.)
[*] Added a [b]summer-themed outfit for each chibi[/b]

[*] Added replay buttons to combat log

notes.title: More New Items on the Beta Branch NOW!!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

The 5 more items we teased last time are now [b]ready to be tested[/b] and are freely available on the beta branch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/85366745e4e1e7a300a38a9e84e3a910eab15e7a.png[/img]

The whole [b]Summer Update[/b], including all the items is planned to go to the main branch on Friday 28th of this month (that’s in one week).

So, to the new items!
[b]Shiny Shell[/b] is a cheap Holy item that heals once, with increasing efficiency based on adjacent Holy items. It can be crafted into the [b]Shell Totem[/b], which is a source of healing and Empower that uses stamina.

The [b]Oil Lamp[/b] is an Epic shop item that scales an affected weapon’s damage and accuracy.

Then, there is the new Legendary item, the [b]Maneki Neko[/b]: When the combined gold value of surrounding items is high enough it increases sales chance, prevents crits and increases the speed of Godly and Unique items!

And finally, there is the first craftable bag with the [b]Box of Prosperity[/b], which keeps part of the functionality of a Box of Riches, while adding space to your inventory.

[h2]Combat Log[/h2]
We have also been working away on the combat log, adding many visual improvements, logging more combat stuff (resisted debuffs, nullified buffs, protected buffs, reflected debuffs...), and counting (like misses, activations, …). With that, we plan to move on to the next big feature soon. The patch also has a set of quality-of-life improvements and UI polish.

[h2]Rainbow Goobert Plush[/h2]
You can still [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/rainbow-goobert-plush]order the plushie[/url]! We need to reach 200 sold plushies for them to be made. And it's only available for a limited time, so order your own Rainbow Goob now!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/rainbow-goobert-plush][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/92bba3c57b582b26f1ba38909182fb151411914c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Beta Branch[/h2]
On [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]our Discord server[/url], you can find instructions on how to join the beta. Also, it's the perfect place to let us know when you encounter bugs or crashes. The new items and combat log changes are expected to have some bugs, so please test everything thoroughly! The beta branch has a separate progress from the main branch, and you can switch back any time.

Anyway, have fun testing all the new things, and stay tuned for our biggest update yet next Friday! :)

notes.title: New Items & More Now on the Beta Branch!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone,[/h2]
we have lots of news!

There are many things to talk about, so before we get into detail, here is a short summary:
[list]
[*] You can order Rainbow Goobert on makeship NOW!
[*] The beta branch is up! You can access and test all the items teased in the previous post.
[*] Also on the beta branch, the combat log now tracks cooldowns and many other things, and we finally have an auto-advance mode! (That will get more and more similar to the actual fight with future updates)
[*] And (surprise!!), there are more item teasers! So the next update will be a [b]big[/b] one.
[/list]

[h2]Rainbow Goobert Plush[/h2]
You can now [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/rainbow-goobert-plush]order the plushie[/url]!  We need to reach 200 sold plushies for them to be made. And it's only available for a limited time, so order your own Rainbow Goob now!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/rainbow-goobert-plush][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/92bba3c57b582b26f1ba38909182fb151411914c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Beta Branch[/h2]
On [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]our Discord server[/url], you can find instructions on how to join the beta. Also, it's the perfect place to let us know when you encounter bugs or crashes. The new items and combat log changes are expected to have some bugs, so please test everything thoroughly! The beta branch has a separate progress from the main branch, and you can switch back any time.

[h2]New Items[/h2]
The new items you can test on the beta branch right now are: 
The [b]Prismatic Orb[/b] is a Godly item that is Vampiric, Magic, Holy, and Dark, and synergizes with all these types! You can use it to make the [b]Prismatic Sword[/b], which uses the same synergies, but …well, to punch people.

Then there are the new [b]Amulets[/b]: Rare items that reveal their effect only after you buy them, and synergize with different build paths. Currently, there are [b]6 different effects[/b] it can gain!

Then, as promised, there is the [b]Toad[/b], to give Reaper another pet to choose from. It synergizes with gaining and using different buffs!

And finally, there is the [b]Stone Golem[/b], a strong fellow that can attack, gain Empower, and stun your opponents! You can craft him on any class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/56d0333b489152b6865e0ada46e6382846f69c92.png[/img]

[h2]Combat Log[/h2]
We are still working our way towards feature completeness of the combat log, so we try to get as many of the requested features in as we can! With the beta update, it can now finally track the states of items like potions, playing cards etc., as well as their current cooldowns. We also added a feature to [b]automatically advance[/b], so you can view the fight again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/1416304a8cdea90035649823a5b3eb291c715a30.jpg[/img]

There are a few more improvements we want to get in before we go on to the next major feature.

[h2]More Items Coming Soon![/h2]
And a surprise for you guys! The next update will have [b]5 more items[/b] in it, stay tuned for [url=https://x.com/backpack_NA]more teasers on our X page[/url]. It won’t be too long until you can try them out as well! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/1dbc2a36d5b0bd6fddb17f5e08a8073750a5a8f0.png[/img]

We often get questions on whether we want to add more items, and the answer is clear: Of course! We have several more sets planned during the early access.

notes.title: Backpack Battles Patch 0.9.8
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

today we have a huge content update! The biggest one since we launched into Early Access two months ago. We want to thank everyone who tested the patch on the beta branch and reported issues 🙏

[h2]New Items[/h2]

This patch comes with 5 new craftable items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/a933baf92327011242d3a2080df83c3f4d3956c0.png[/img]

[h3]King Crown[/h3]
Protects buffs and makes gems socketed inside more effective.

[h3]King Goobert[/h3]
A royal species of Goobert that heals, protects buffs, and makes gemstones socketed inside stronger.

[h3]Serpent Staff[/h3]
Neutral Magic Staff upgrade that applies ramping Poison.

[h3]Spiked Staff[/h3]
Berserker finally has her own staff! This one generates Empower.

[h3]Thornbloom[/h3]
Weapon that generates Spikes and Empower and increases your health when you gain Empower stacks.

[h2]New Pyromancer Outfit[/h2]

This outfit is inspired by the Obsidian dragon and now available to unlock in the wardrobe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/32ae93bf4061bb641a9398227280055f79d5fc49.png[/img]


[h2]Item Info Panel[/h2]

In the item library, you can now find a new panel that shows information for every item such as
[list]
[*] Its gold cost
[*] Which classes can buy or craft it
[*] How often you found the item, how often you bought it in the shop
[*] Your top win counter and your best rank when surviving with the item in your backpack
[*] Flavor text (currently not all items have their own text yet, we're working on it!)
[*] Its crafting ingredients and/or gate item
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/c15b4105c239fa65c2e873777618c5a284959220.png[/img]

Your stats will be recorded from 0.9.8 onward. We will add more information to the panel based on your feedback!

To switch between the filters and this info panel, click the tabs on the top right or press arrow keys/trigger buttons on your controller.

You can also earn [b]stars[/b] now! Every item can have a Bronze, Silver or Gold star, or a Diamond, depending on how far you made it with it in your backpack. In the item library, press Alt to show the medals directly on the items.

With the new items we make some balance adjustments, there will probably be more changes next week when we can judge the impact the new items have on the meta.

notes.title: New Patch Schedule & What's Coming Up
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

As we already teased, the time has come to [b]reduce the frequency of balance patches[/b]. So there will be no balance patch this week. We will still make changes pretty regularly, just not every single week.

We think the game is at a point where the meta needs more time to settle, and players could use more time to experiment with things as they are. That being said, after we add new content, we will be quick with adjustments if necessary.

notes.title: Backpack Battles Patch 0.9.4
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

We released Backpack Battles exactly [b]4 weeks ago[/b], and we can say that it's been a massive success! The game means a lot to us, and we will continue to make it the best game we can 🤍

Today we have some more experimental changes for you! This patch adds [b]badges[/b], which are unique items that can be found at any point during a run, but have an especially high chance in the first round (25%!). They are designed to add variety and give you runs that otherwise would be impossible. 

We add 6 badges, and all of them alter [b]which class items you have access to[/b]. Let’s all test this out, and see how we like it. It is to be expected that we adjust the frequency, and if we all decide we like the feature, we will probably add more badges as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/3a130c53be9445d5d3a52b0fbe241ae4b33cec48.png[/img]

Also, we are having a poll on [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]Discord[/url] and in our Chinese community. So far, there are 3 main takeaways for us: 
[list]
[*] You guys want a high variance class - so the Adventurer will be made to cover this!
[*] You want more Uniques - so we will keep adding those!
[*] And you want more items in the base pool - which we already started designing!
[/list]

Balance-wise, Ranger, Reaper and Berserker seem even. Pyromancers still perform very well, but the gap isn’t large, so we will adjust very carefully.
The goal of this patch is to lift up the subclasses and items that don’t see a lot of play yet.
We will continue with weekly patches until we feel like every subclass is viable in some situation!

- Dorothea and Mario

notes.title: Backpack Battles is bundling up with Balatro!
notes.content:
We have a special surprise for you today!

[h2]Can't Put It Down![/h2]

To celebrate our participation in Steam's [b]Deckbuilders Fest[/b], we collaborated with Balatro for the [b]"Can't Put It Down"[/b] bundle - and it's live now! Get both Backpack Battles and Balatro for a [b]10% discount[/b] - or complete the bundle if you already own one of the games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38429

Balatro is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos. We love it!

[h2]Jimbo is here![/h2]

That's why we decided to add our version of Balatro's most prominent Joker [b]Jimbo[/b] to Backpack Battles: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/db928edc43739101702a8d1cd575e9a0fdff863c.png[/img]

Jimbo is a Playing Card, which means you can buy him in the shop when you play as Reaper and have a Deck of Cards in your inventory. His effect changes based on the cards before him in the card chain - you need sets of two, three, or four of the same playing cards. To make the most use of him, place him late in the card chain and count the number of pairs, triplets, and quads. 

[h2]Harlequin Reaper Outfit[/h2]

And that's not all - this update also comes with a new Poker-themed outfit for the Reaper - dress her up as [b]Harlequin[/b]! As always, you can unlock it in the Wardrobe with trophies, and mix-and-match it with the other outfits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/5dc3f703a27ee31f87ac4f839899f19352d9efce.png[/img]


Both Jimbo and the outfit are part of version 0.9.2c which is live now!

notes.title: All Backpack Battles recipes list
notes.content:
What are the best Backpack Battles recipes? This overview of all Backpack Battles recipes will help you find the best item combinations. In strategy game Backpack Battles, you can link certain items together to create a more powerful item. The only problem? The game won't reveal the recipes until you've crafted the item. As combined items are usually stronger than default items, you can use this Backpack Battles list of all recipes to find every combination and improve your chances of winning. We've also included a Backpack Battles tier list for every item obtained through recipes, so you'll know which ones are the best.

Combining items in Backpack Battles is quite simple. If two items in your possession are compatible, you'll see a blue glowing line when hovering over them. To combine these two items, place them next to each other in your backpack, which will spark an orange glowing line. Win a battle while the connected items remain in place, and the Backpack Battle recipe is complete. As soon as you return to the preparation phase of the roguelike game, you'll find the new item in your backpack.

notes.title: Hotfixes & Help with Technical Issues
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,[/h3]

Backpack Battles has been out for 4 days now! We've been busy fixing bugs and have already pushed some hotfix patches. You can view the recent patch notes ingame by clicking the version number on the bottom right. We also post them on our [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]Discord server[/url].

We wanted to address some common technical issues and frequently asked questions.

[h2]Steam Deck Issues[/h2]
For some reason we don't know, Steam doesn't launch the correct build on Steam Deck, and the game instantly crashes when you try to start it up. The workaround to get it to launch is by enabling and disabling Compatibility.

In your library click on Backpack Battles, click the cog button on the right, open Properties, Compatibility, check "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool", uncheck again, close properties. It should start normally from that point onward.

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
The game has controller support, and with the 0.9.0f patch, you can reconfigure gamepad inputs in the options. It should display icons that match the controller you're using. Please give feedback, and let us know if you encounter issues, so we can add "Full controller support" to the store page.

[h2]Game does not start[/h2]
This seems to be an issue with missing dependencies on some systems that we are trying to figure out. In many cases, verifying the game files fixes it. We also checked some settings in the backend to hopefully fix this issue. 

[h2]Family Sharing does not work[/h2]
We do not know what causes this, and we have contacted Steam support several days ago but haven't got a response yet.

[h3]Update: Steam support fixed it![/h3]

We're doing our best to make the game accessible to all of you, thank you for helping us with bug reports etc.! We're also planning a balance patch soon.

[b]Thanks for playing, have fun! [/b]

notes.content:
It's not the fault of Diablo 4, Last Epoch, or Path of Exile. Some tropes, no matter how fussy or fiddly, die hard, and for decades now the classic RPG game has been built around - for better or worse - a big, tricky inventory system. Skyrim has one. Fallout has one. Hotkeys help, but with so many crafting and customization options, it takes a long time to find precisely the doohickey you need. Taking this tentpole of the RPG genre as its inspiration, one new indie game has exploded on Steam. With 100,000 copies sold in a single day, tens of thousands of players, and a 10/10 user rating already, now's the time to check out one of 2024's true surprise hits.

Ever since the early days of Diablo, inventory management has been one of those frustrating aspects of gaming that you just have to deal with. It's been a constant for many years, through many RPGs including Fallout, Skyrim, and of course Baldur's Gate 3. Resident Evil 4 was a high point, with its particular brand of briefcase Tetris, but now a delightful new indie game called Backpack Battles has turned the strife of sorting your stuff into a frantic multiplayer game in the style of TFT and Super Auto Pets, and it's already blowing up on Steam at launch.

notes.title: Backpack Battles is in EARLY ACCESS NOW! 🎒⚔
notes.content:
[h2]Pack Your Backpacks![/h2]
Hi everyone,

The time has finally come. Backpack Battles is available on Steam! We are so happy you can finally play what we have been working on all this time, now grab your bag and play!

You can now choose between four classes: Ranger, Reaper, Pyromancer, and Berserker!
All classes have five subclasses to choose from in the 8th round. There are tons of new content to explore!

[previewyoutube=SJAbeIH1f_4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Early Access Plans[/h2]
Our work is not done here. There are plenty of features we want to add during Early Access. And here is our [b]roadmap[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/1b047bfa5f20d1469fb3b11cf39e04c68c4f368c.png[/img]

The points are roughly ordered, and multiple things will probably progress in parallel. But the first thing will be to work on the [b]new classes[/b] - it is to be expected that there are bugs to fix and balancing to address.

[b]Lobbies[/b] are a feature that was frequently requested in the past. We have made progress behind the scenes and built a successful proof of concept, but it is a large feature and we don’t know how much time it will take.

Another feature we planned for so long is to give you guys more [b]statistics[/b] about every item in the item library. We feel like it could be really cool to see how often you bought an item, how far you came with it, and for example, what your highest rank win was with that item. We also have been writing flavor texts that we plan to display there.

The [b]combat log[/b] has been a favorite since we added it, and we plan to work on it more until release. There are a few features that would be helpful, like a search function and a way to see precisely when an item activates.

We also plan to touch the [b]ranking system[/b]. We can’t say too much yet, but it is very well possible that it will be seasonal. With the release, the rankings from the demo were already reset, and it is very possible that with large changes or seasons, there will be more resets.

The [b]unique item pool[/b] has grown substantially since we introduced it, often with seasonal items. We want to produce many additional Uniques, and we have lots of ideas already!

And of course, we will be working on [b]new outfits[/b] for the characters. Currently, the new classes have two outfits and two chibi-style outfits.

[h3]Full Release[/h3]
The features that define the end of Early access and the start of full release are the 5th character and Steam achievements. We plan to add the “Adventurer”, a class that stands over typical class restrictions and starts each round with random items, similar to the “Present” unique. We received many requests to give the present a larger role, and we think this is the coolest way. This also means that according to plan, the adventurer would not have any (or very few) class-specific items. Also, keep in mind that this is in the concept phase, so it’s subject to change.

[h3]Patches & Demo[/h3]
Also, we will shift our patch schedule. We are very proud of our streak of 39 consecutive content patches on Sundays, but for the Early Access, we will switch to less regular larger patches. This will give us time to work on the big features we have planned. 

About the demo: It will remain available both on Steam and itch.io! If you’re not sure whether you want to buy the full game, definitely check the demo out!

[h2]Hot Bundles[/h2]

We are excited to offer you two awesome bundles with a 10% discount! 
Both Slay the Spire and Brotato are incredible games you should not miss out on!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39016

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39017

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

It is important to us to thank you all. This game has far surpassed our wildest expectations already. As game developers, all we want is for people to enjoy our game. Having the game resonate with so many of you is a dream come true. We will continue to give our best and make Backpack Battles the best game we can.

We want to give a shoutout to [b]IndieArk[/b] who supported us a lot and even organized a localization into Traditional Chinese for release. 

If you like the game, the best way to support us is by [b]writing a review[/b] on Steam. Reviews are extremely important for visibility on the store and for this game to succeed! We would appreciate it very much.

We’re looking forward to reading your opinions and discussing the game’s features on our [url=https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr]Discord server[/url]. You can also share item ideas and your favorite builds there!

Have fun! 🤍

notes.title: Backpack Battles is Coming to Early Access March 8, 2024!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

We have a big surprise for you all! 

[previewyoutube=qqhlUfR3B2Q;full][TRAILER][/previewyoutube]

[b]We have decided to go into Early Access in early March of this year![/b]

This means you will have access to all classes earlier than previously announced.
We have been asked many times if we can launch earlier, and this way we can 🥳

From the start of Early Access, BOTH the Berserker and the Pyromancer will be fully playable. Each of them comes with a full set of [b]5 subclasses[/b] and already a total of [b]25 to 30 class-specific items[/b].

The goal of the EA phase will be to polish and balance the new classes. We are aiming for a pretty short duration of a few months until the full release. And of course, we’ll be adding more items and general quality-of-life features during EA - and who knows what else!

[h3]The Berserker[/h3]
The Berserker is rough, tough, and angry. Her core mechanic is [b]Battle Rage[/b], which gives her increased attack speed and damage resistance when in danger. Many Berserker-specific items interact with Battle Rage and do something special when it activates!
The Berserker starts with a [b]Forging Hammer[/b], which she can use to upgrade items.

[h3]The Pyromancer[/h3]
Some people love to see the world burn. Literally. Pyromancers find arson awesome!
The Pyromancer can both buy and generate 1-gold [b]Flames[/b], that generate Heat on their own. Flames can be used to set items on fire or infuse them with Heat.
Some of her signature items can use Heat as a resource for massive effects, such as [b]reincarnation[/b]!


So, here are some questions we think you might have and our answers:

[i]Will you still update the demo in parallel?[/i]

The demo will stay up, but it will no longer get content updates. Instead, the Early Access version will be updated. This way, the Early Access-exclusive content does not lead to unfairness for the demo players.

[i]Will demo players be matched against EA players?[/i]

No, the player pools will be separated.

[i]Will my progress from the demo transfer?[/i]

Ranking will probably reset towards Early Access and possibly during Early Access as well.
We will, however, do our best to transfer all unlocks (trophies, skins, etc)

notes.title: A Year Full of Backpacks
notes.content:
It was a wild year. Without any exaggeration, a life-changing one for us.
Some of you don't know this, but the core team [b]is just us two[/b]: Doro and Mario. We live together, code together and design together.

Before February, there was no “Backpack Battles”, not even the idea to make something like that.
And out of nowhere, you appeared and played our game.
We somehow went from an idea, that we were unsure about if it would even work - to what has been the [b]most played demo on Steam[/b] for months.

[h3]You often ask us how much of this was planned,[/h3]
so yeah... the whole game is a big experiment.
This is not the type of game that can be planned too much, and we decided early to embrace the unknowable rather than try to control it. The best ideas only ever come up when the game is actively being played - without this approach, we would have never discovered some (now) core features such as recipes, or the ability to lift bags after they were first placed.

We are also still on a streak, and managed to patch some new content into the game [b]every Sunday[/b] since we released the demo on May 30, 2023!

[h3]So, where is this all gonna lead us?[/h3]
Here is what we know:
In parallel with the weekly content, we have been working on the new classes and subclasses behind the scenes. When we launch, we will do that with 2 more classes, the [b]Pyromancer[/b] and the [b]Berserker[/b], and a total of [b]20 subclasses[/b] (5 per class). This has been a hefty chunk of content to prepare, but we are very happy with it and well on schedule! (surprisingly)
We can’t give an exact number of items yet, but it will be a substantial increase from the current state 😀

There is also some more great news regarding the launch on the horizon that we can’t talk about just yet. Stay tuned for more announcements :)

So, thanks everybody for playing our game! 💛
I hope you have fun, we promise we will do everything we can to make it the best game possible.

And Happy New Year!

notes.title: Backpack Battles Patch 0.6.2
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

We continue with the big changes!

In this patch, our primary goal is to streamline [b]Spikes-related items[/b]. We simplified the effects of Thorn Whip, Spiked Shield and Bow and Arrow. We have made no direct adjustments to the Lightsaber yet, but quite a few indirect ones. If this isn't enough we will be quick with the adjustments.

We also add two new Ranger-specific recipes this week - [b]Tusk Piercer[/b] and [b]Fortuna's Grace[/b]. These crafts will give Rangers more tools to shape their build in the mid-game. 

Last week’s experiments went well, thanks a ton to everyone who gave their feedback in a respectful way! Every change was controversial, but we aligned with the majority of players on how to move forward: Keep the scaling rerolls cost and spacious start inventories while moving the subclasses back to round 8.

This patch brings a much-requested quality-of-life feature: [b]reconfigurable controls[/b]! You can define to 2 keys for many features such as rotating items and shifting your inventory in the Options. You can now also add hotkeys for rerolling, starting battle and pushing all items to storage. 
There are many more changes, check them out below!

notes.title: Backpack Battles Patch 0.6.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

We're here with another patch - and it's a very experimental one! 

Apart from a few reworks and effect changes, we have changed both classes' [b]starting inventories[/b]. You now have more bag space available from the beginning and more gold in the first round, giving you more possibilities to shape your early game. 

Next, the [b]price of rerolls[/b] is now increased to 2 gold for the round after rolling 3 times, and to 3 after 9 rolls. 

We also added a new common item, the [b]Lump of Coal[/b]. You can socket it into weapons and armor like gemstones. 

Please keep in mind we want to find out how we can make the most fun game out of Backpack Battles - and that sometimes requires making bigger changes. We are checking in with how you like them on our Discord and by watching streams. And we're not afraid to roll the changes back either. 

Anyway, have fun with the patch and thanks for playing! <3

In this mode, you must make it through round 18 without losing all your lives. If you survive, you win more ranking and bonus trophies.

notes.title: Backpack Battles Patch 0.3.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we have some bagtactular changes for you today! 

The largest addition is the [b]Combat Log[/b], which logs everything that happened in a battle, so you can review it afterward. You can even hover over entries to see the HP/stamina/buff stacks at the time. 
This should help you understand what exactly happened in a fierce fight. 
It is very much work-in-progress though, and we will improve it over the coming weeks. We expect events to be missing, let us know what you find :)

notes.title: Backpack Battles Patch 0.3.1

Many of you have been asking for an ingame crafting recipe collection - it is ready! You can open the recipe sheet in the bottom right in the shop. It shows the ingredients for the items you have crafted. Let us know how you like it!

This update brings 8 new items, which makes it our biggest content patch so far. We introduced a new mechanic, Mana, that serves as a resource for many of the new magic items. Have fun trying out the new items and recipes!

notes.title: Backpack Battles Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thank you to everyone who has tried out the demo! If you liked it, please put Backpack Battles on your wishlist - and follow, if you want to get informed about updates.

We got a lot of feedback and prepared a huuuge balance/fix patch for you. There are also two new items, one of which is craftable. 

We plan to update the game every Sunday. The best place to leave feedback, bug reports & ideas is our Discord! Join our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/sbEkqeUKNr

Here's the full change log for 0.2.0:

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] ADDED Vampiric Armor (craftable)
[*] ADDED Shield of Valor
[*] Added a button to show the backpacks after each battle
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed matchmaking in rare cases finding late game opponents in early rounds
[*] Fixed Light Sabor consuming Block instead of Blind
[*] Blinding Light now uses the correct duration (3s instead of 4s)
[*] Fixed Poison Dagger not applying the stacks when triggered by a Stun
[*] Stone and Ruby Whelp are now tagged as weapons
[*] Fixed tooltips with “Blind” also showing the context hint for “Block”
[*] Fixed Flute/Fanfare not visually activating
[*] Fixed a visual glitch happening when the player open the shop before the ranking was loaded
[*] Improved file handling to deal better with corrupted saves
[*] Fixed Spiked Shield triggering too often
[*] Fixed tooltips of items still showing the old bag effects
[*] Fixed items being hoverable a moment after selling them
[*] Restricted effective mouse position to the game window to prevent weirdness
[*] Fixed a glitch where an item could be bought after leaving the shop, leading to a crash and broken save file
[*] Fixed fanfare-glitter particles looking janky when clicked away too fast in the round before
[*] Item progress shader now looks correct for items that face down or left
[*] Fixed Ruby Egg hatching early when continuing a run
[*] Fixed a problem where the time scale slider could be pressed after the fight ended, setting the whole game speed to weird values
[*] Fixed Thornwhip not applying the damage bonus
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Light Sabor: Reduced Blinding Light stacks 10 -> 7
[*] Hungry Blade: Reduced Vampirism conversion from 2 to 1, now adds 1 Vampirism at the start, -1 damage
[*] Bloodthorne: Reduced Vampirism conversion from 3 to 2. Damage reduced to 3-6
[*] Demonic Flask: 1.0 damage per debuff -> 0.7 damage per debuff
[*] Wooden Sword: max damage +1
[*] Hero Sword: max damage +1
[*] Spear: max damage +1, now removes 4 Block
[*] Pan: max damage +1
[*] Dagger/Poison Dagger: max damage +1
[*] Storage Coffin: Chance 35% -> 25%
[*] Spike Shield: Now gains a spike every 15 Block instead of 10
[*] Fanfare: Cooldown 5s -> 3s
[*] Flute: now randomly gives 10 Block, 2 stamina, or 2 Lucky
[*] Bow and Arrow: Cooldown 4s -> 3.5s
[*] Rib Saw Blade: stamina cost 2 -> 1.5
[*] Thorn Whip: now gains +1 Spike on Crit
[*] Garlic: Block 5 -> 4
[*] Holy Armor: Poison cleanse cooldown 3s -> 2s
[*] Fly Agaric: Gold cost 2 -> 3
[/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Many tooltip improvements! Texts are more consistent, show less redundant information, highlighting and layouting are better, they highlight trigger conditions now ...
[*] “Affected” stars now show in slots that are outside the backpack area
[*] Items now show the slots they would use on tiles outside the backpack area
[*] Items now show their size and stars (what slots they affect) when hovered in shop
[*] Ranking now loads much faster!
[*] Item overlap order in shop is now much nicer (bottom is in front)
[*] Added hover tooltip for backpack power
[*] Shop music now loops correctly
[/list]
